description: Export 3DEC blocks/zones to rigid block in PFC .

keywords.name: filename
keywords.description: Specify the name of the output file. This file is an assembly of PFC commands.

keywords.name: by-zone
keywords.description: Export tetrahedral zones. By default, 3DEC blocks are exported.

syntax.7.0: grid [{binary <b> | block-ids <b> | face-groups <b> | merge-join <b> | offset <v> | zone-groups <b> | filename <s>} ...] [range]

description.7.0: Export the zoned blocks as a FLAC3D grid file instead of PFC commands; the default file name is 3dec.f3grid. Options: binary <b>: Write a binary file, the default. With off the file is the text *FLAC3D grid format.; offset <v>: Shift the exported coordinates by v.; block-ids <b>, merge-join <b>, face-groups <b>, zone-groups <b>: Listed by the engine; the manual does not describe them.; filename <s>: Name of the output file. It must come before the range.
description.9.0: Export the zoned blocks as a FLAC3D grid file instead of PFC commands; the default file name is 3dec.f3grid. Options: binary <b>: Write a binary file, the default. With off the file is the text *FLAC3D grid format.; offset <v>: Shift the exported coordinates by v.; block-ids <b>, merge-join <b>: Listed by the engine; the manual does not describe them.; filename <s>: Name of the output file. It must come before the range.

keywords.name: precision
keywords.description: Numeric precision of the export. (Listed by 3DEC 9.7.47; not on the manual page.)
